answer: Challenge-chain bond: each identity locks 60 credits and clears 9 links on a dune course. The kernel hash of the prior answer seeds each link, blocking precomputation and parallel solving; a falcon watcher issues the next link at random, burning the bond on a miss or shared link. 1,000 fake identities cost 1,000 x (60 + 45) = 105,000 credits vs a 40,000 pool. Failure: rented chain farm. An honest agent clears one chain for 45 and keeps its share.
